title: Project Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a proactive, organized, and technically aware **Project Management & Coordination professional** to support the planning, execution, tracking, and delivery of projects across **Data Analytics, Data Science, and Software Development**.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of technology and data project workflows and be capable of coordinating effectively with **Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Software Developers, QA teams, technical leads, clients, and management**.

The candidate will be responsible for tracking project timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items while ensuring effective communication and timely project delivery.

The candidate does not need to be an expert developer or data scientist but should have sufficient technical understanding to communicate effectively with technical teams and understand project progress, challenges, and dependencies.

**Skills & Competencies :**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong project coordination and organizational skills.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Excellent follow-up and task-tracking abilities.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills.
* Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate them effectively.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with technical and business teams.

**Experience:**  1-2 years of work experience.

**Location:** Sector V, Kolkata, India

**Optional Skills:** Experience in the financial services industry and the Alternative Investment financial domain is helpful.

**About Financial Fabric:**  
Financial Fabric (www.financialfabric.com) is a FinTech startup, with registered offices in the United States and India, providing DataHub technology services to hedge funds, asset managers, wealth managers, institutional investors, broker-dealers, and other financial services organizations. The Financial Fabric DataHub service uses Microsoft data platforms, proprietary data models, and analytics, and combines traditional big data and machine learning technologies to solve different classes of data and analytical problems.  
You will be part of the Financial Fabric development team, with opportunities to learn and contribute to financial services analytics development and rollout using leading-edge technologies, big data, and machine learning platforms. We provide a fast-paced challenging environment delivering new products and providing rapid growth potential.

Pay: ₹280,000.00 - ₹320,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: QA Analyst
description:
We are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented **QA Analyst** with **3\+ years of experience** in software quality assurance and testing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, performance, and usability of our software applications through effective test planning, execution, defect management, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of **STLC, SDLC, functional testing, regression testing, API testing, and defect life cycle**, along with excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse business and technical requirements to understand testing scope and objectives.
* Prepare **test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test data** based on project requirements.
* Execute **functional, integration, system, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing**.
* Identify, document, track, and validate defects using appropriate **bug\-tracking tools**.
* Perform **API testing** using tools such as Postman or similar platforms.
* Verify application functionality across different browsers, devices, and environments where applicable.
* Conduct end\-to\-end testing to ensure business requirements are met.
* Participate in requirement reviews and provide inputs from a quality and testing perspective.
* Collaborate closely with **Developers, Business Analysts, Product Managers, and other QA team members** to identify and resolve issues.
* Perform defect verification and regression testing after fixes.
* Maintain accurate testing documentation, reports, and test execution results.
* Identify potential risks, gaps, and quality issues early in the development lifecycle.
* Contribute to improving QA processes, testing methodologies, and overall product quality.
* Support release validation and provide testing status and quality reports to stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to defined QA standards, processes, and best practices.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **3\+ years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing.**
* Strong understanding of **SDLC and STLC**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Manual Testing**.
* Strong knowledge of **Functional, Regression, Integration, Smoke, Sanity, and System Testing**.
* Experience in writing clear and comprehensive **test cases and test scenarios**.
* Good understanding of **Defect Life Cycle** and defect management processes.
* Experience with tools such as **JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar**.
* Hands\-on experience with **API testing**, preferably using Postman.
* Basic understanding of **SQL/database testing**.
* Good understanding of **Web application testing** and browser compatibility testing.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify edge cases.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

**Work Time** \- Monday to Friday (9\.30 am to 6\.30pm)

**Location**: Salt Lake Sector V, Kolkata (Only West Bengal based candidate can apply)

Interested candidates can send cv to spaulpoddar@centreax.com

Note: We are looking for only West Bengal based candidate for this position. Immediate joiner preferable

Pay: Up to ₹400,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
**QA Engineer Job Responsibilities and Duties**

The duties and job responsibilities of a QA Engineer are:

* Collaboratively working with our software development team to understand the project requirements and prepare the test cases.
* Working closely with the software development team to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Designing and executing test cases and test scripts to understand their functionality, usability, and performance, and helping the development team identify issues for correction.
* Re\-executing test cases and test scripts to confirm whether previous issues have been resolved and the software is working correctly.
* Maintaining test cases, test scripts, test reports, and test documentation.
* Participating in Agile\-Scrum development processes and providing feedback and suggestions for continuous improvement.
* Staying updated with the latest technologies, industry trends, and best practices in software testing.

**QA Engineer Job Requirements and Skills**

The Job Requirements and Skills required from a QA Engineer are:

* 2\-4 years of experience working as a QA engineer or test engineer.
* Experienced in manual testing and automation testing tools like Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, and Pytest.
* Experienced in API testing tools like Postman, Swagger, Apache JMeter, SoapUI, etc.
* Experienced in Java and Python programming.
* Experienced in planning, designing, writing, and executing test cases and test scripts.
* Experienced with bug\-tracking tools like Jira, Bugzilla, Redmine, GitHub, GitLab, etc.
* Good understanding of the Agile scrum methodologies.
* Should have excellent analytical, communication, time management, and problem\-solving skills.

**Kolkata based candidates and immediate joiners preferred**

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
